Backend Engineer
Fernwood Logistics | Chennai

Requirements
- 2+ years of professional backend development experience
- 3+ years of experience with Python required
- Strong SQL and relational database design
- Experience building and consuming REST APIs
- Experience with at least one cloud provider (AWS, GCP or Azure)
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Responsibilities
- Design and build services that process shipment events at scale
- Own services in production including on-call rotation
- Improve database query performance
- Mentor interns and junior engineers

Preferred
- Experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ
- Kubernetes
- Infrastructure as code, especially Terraform
- Prior experience in logistics or supply chain

This role requires 3+ years of Python. Candidates without demonstrable Python
experience will not be considered.
